sources.quote: I hereby prescribe the following documentary requirements for aliens desiring admission into the Philippine Islands
shall then supersede the provisions of Executive Order No. 6987 of March 9, 1935

clauses.quote: I hereby prescribe the following documentary requirements for aliens desiring admission into the Philippine Islands.
clauses.object: aliens desiring admission into the Philippine Islands (documentary requirements), under Act of May 22, 1918 (40 Stat. 559) as extended by Act of March 2, 1921

clauses.quote: The provisions of this Order shall be applicable to Chinese except as may be otherwise provided by special laws and regulations governing the entry of such aliens.
clauses.object: Chinese aliens, except as otherwise provided by special laws and regulations governing their entry

clauses.quote: 1. All aliens coming to the Philippine Islands must present unexpired passports or official documents in the nature of passports issued by the governments of the countries to which they owe allegiance or other travel documents showing their origin and identity, prescribed in regulations issued by the Secretary of State, and valid passport visas or, in lieu of passport visas, if passing in transit through the Philippine Islands to a foreign destination, transit certificates granted by authorized officers of the United States, except in the following cases:
clauses.object: all aliens entering the Philippines: unexpired passports/travel documents and valid passport visas or transit certificates

clauses.quote: (a) An alien who is a through passenger on a vessel touching at a port of the Philippine Islands, landing temporarily while the vessel is in port.
clauses.object: through-passenger aliens landing temporarily

clauses.quote: (b) An alien seaman serving on a vessel of any nationality touching at a port of the Philippine Islands. (Masters of vessels are not required to present visaed crew lists for the Philippine Islands.)
clauses.kind: exception/proviso (incl. parenthetical relieving masters of visaed crew lists)
clauses.object: alien seamen on vessels touching a Philippine port

clauses.quote: (c) An alien arriving in the Philippine Islands in transit to the United States or to another Ameiican possession. (Such an alien, however, may be required to exhibit those documents necessary for his entry into the United States or the other possession to which he is proceeding.)
clauses.kind: exception/proviso (incl. reservation of power to require documents for onward entry)
clauses.object: aliens in transit to the United States or another American possession

clauses.quote: 2. The Governor General is authorized in his discretion to waive the passport and visa requirements for aliens in the following categories:
clauses.object: Governor General: discretionary waiver of passport and visa requirements

clauses.quote: (a) An alien lawfully resident in the Philippine Islands who is returning from a temporary visit abroad.
clauses.object: resident alien returning from temporary visit abroad

clauses.quote: (b) An alien child born subsequent to the issuance of the visa or transit certificate of an accompanying parent, the visa or transit certificate not having expired.
clauses.object: child born after issuance of accompanying parent's unexpired visa/transit certificate

clauses.quote: (c) An alien child born during the temporary visit abroad of a mother who is a citizen of the United States or of the Philippine Islands or of an alien mother lawfully resident in the Philippine Islands.
clauses.object: child born during temporary visit abroad of US/Philippine-citizen mother or lawfully resident alien mother

clauses.quote: (d) An alien who applies for temporary admission, in cases of emergency.
clauses.object: aliens seeking temporary admission in emergencies

clauses.quote: 3. No passport visa or transit certificate shall be granted to an alien whose entry would be contrary to the public safety.
clauses.object: aliens whose entry would be contrary to public safety

clauses.quote: The Executive Secretary of the Panama Canal is hereby authorized to issue passport visas and transit certificates to aliens going to the Philippine Islands from the Canal Zone;
clauses.object: Executive Secretary of the Panama Canal: issue visas/transit certificates to aliens going from the Canal Zone

clauses.quote: the Governor of American Samoa is hereby authorized to issue passport visas and transit certificates to aliens going to the Philippine Islands from American Samoa;
clauses.object: Governor of American Samoa: same, aliens from American Samoa

clauses.quote: the Governor of Guam is hereby authorized to issue passport visas and transit certificates to aliens going to the Philippine Islands from Guam.
clauses.object: Governor of Guam: same, aliens from Guam

clauses.quote: This order shall take effect immediately
clauses.object: this order

clauses.quote: and shall supersede the provisions of Executive Order No. 5869 of June 30, 1932, entitled "Documents Required of Aliens Entering the United States," so far as they govern aliens entering the Philippine Islands.
clauses.object: EO 5869 of June 30, 1932, 'Documents Required of Aliens Entering the United States', only so far as it governs aliens entering the Philippine Islands
